line.comment: * Task 1328.
* Initialization.
* Add-Ons 1.12.3: [Carrier] class is defined as ALL capital ships and M6! Must check if the ship is huge (only M1, M2, M7, TL) and has docking bays instead.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: Moved initialization to here.
* Add-Ons 1.12.3: This is a persistent saved task, so restart it explicitly when the script version changes.
* Stop this task if the ship lacks docking slots.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Continue instead of return.
* === Repair docked ships ===
* 5000 is mayhem 3 default rep amount below..
* M3 typical hull - 60000, = 12 cycles, 12 minutes
* M6 typical hull - 300000 = 60 cycles = 1 hour
* M1 typical hull - 700000
* M2 5 million
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: Ship modifiers: Carriers repair 1.5x better than base. Aran repairs 6x better than base, aka 4x better than standard carriers.
* fix hull
* Mordan2 add
* set maintenance factor to 100 for all docked carrier ships.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: Only for REAL carriers.
* === Player only: assign support ship tasks to available followers ===
* Mordan2 add.

* We periodcally check to ensure that any 'owned' dockable ships by this carrier are NOT members of any fleet, as they are by definition support ships and this role would be in conflict with the role of a fleet ship.
* Additionally, if the player manually re-homebases a ship to a carrier, there was nothing in the system that would periodically pick up on the

* fact that the carrier now has a new support ship, and so no support task would ever run for that ship and the ship would never undock or even be named appropriately. So now we assign the support task.
* do if $ship == [THIS]
* continue
* write to logfile 1 append=[TRUE] printf: fmt='%s %s', [THIS], 'Testing owned ship-', $ship, null, null
* Ship must be able to dock at the carrier.
* Expanded 2.2 (ported from FoF): A Freighter or TM homebased here never plays a support role; leave it alone.
* Ignore if player is currently flying this ship.
* Add-Ons 1.12.3: Ship must be free before removing from fleet, making it a support ship, and hiding it from property menu.
* If the ship is in any fleet, remove it.
* If Support task is not running, start it.
* === Repair spaceborne ships ===
* Mordan2: If this is an actual carrier (a huge ship with docking support), gradually repair other ships currently in the fleet.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: Cleaned up code.
* Expanded 2.2: Unlike FoF, which restricts spaceborne repair to M1s, Expanded allows any huge ship with docking bays to perform repairs. This maintains player/AI parity.
* This is a player ship. Must be a fleet leader, a real carrier, and not currently attacking in order to repair spaceborne ships.
* Add-Ons 1.12.4: NPCs also benefit.
* This is an NPC ship; repair our followers. Must be a squadron leader, a real carrier, and not currently attacking in order to repair spaceborne ships.
* end Mordan2
* Ship must be:
* 1. Not docked
* 2. Not attacking
* Add-Ons 2.2: Fighter is now eligible to allow fleet fighters to repair.
